findings.finding: The checked-in integration TB models cmd_doutb with always_comb and therefore does not itself prove the frozen one-cycle native command-BRAM fetch boundary.
findings.independent_resolution: The verifier-only tb_execution_fabric_sync_gap.sv replaces only the memory model with a registered read enabled by cmd_enb and reruns the full three-case flow. It passes the exact DMA_LOAD bank1/bank2, GEMM, DMA_STORE, END sequence and all error/recovery cases.
findings.promotion_effect: non_blocking_after_independent_gap_pass; strengthen the checked-in regression before later revisions

findings.component: bank2 URAM and unplaced OOC timing
findings.finding: Vivado reports Synth 8-6013 for the bank2 UltraRAM (one pipeline stage found versus three recommended), and the positive synthesized-OOC WHS is only 0.057 ns. The design is not placed or routed.
findings.evidence: Fresh exact-source OOC still passes at 5 ns with WNS 1.577 ns, WHS 0.057 ns and WPWS 1.800 ns. The worst hold path is an internal FDRE-to-RAMD32 path, so internal hold timing was not hidden by the external-port hold exceptions.
findings.promotion_effect: non_blocking_for_reusable_integration; mandatory reassessment during placed/routed board integration

promotion.basis: No P0, P1 or P2 finding. Frozen identities and children are exact, both exact-source and synchronous-BRAM gap XSIM pass, lint is clean, and fresh 200 MHz synthesized-OOC timing/resource/DRC/methodology evidence passes.
promotion.promoted_scope: execution_fabric reusable RTL integration packet only

structural_audit.selected_source_only_MM2S_mux: passed dynamic legal-traffic checks and static priority/ready audit
structural_audit.MM2S_collision_policy: illegal by invariant; exact RTL contains a simulation $onehot0 assertion and deterministic 0-then-1-then-2 priority with ready returned only to the selected source
structural_audit.completion_release_identity: engine completion_bank, not vendor sequence tag
structural_audit.GEMM_interface: bank and dimensions only; compatibility out_base_addr fixed to zero by the dispatcher

functional_audit.end_to_end_sequence: passed: DMA_LOAD bank1 and bank2, external GEMM ACT/WGT/OUT, DMA_STORE bank3, END
functional_audit.exact_payloads: passed: ACT256, WGT128 and OUT1024 from real XPM-backed memories
functional_audit.valid_ready_backpressure_stability: passed for vendor commands, S2MM payload and GEMM command
functional_audit.two_distinct_bank_loads: passed in program order with exactly three physical packed MM2S bank writes total
functional_audit.completion_bank_vs_sequence_tag: passed for both MM2S loads and S2MM store; bank3 store uses a sequence tag unequal to 3
functional_audit.descriptor_capacity_reject: passed code 0x06, zero vendor command, zero memory write and ownership drain
functional_audit.transport_fault: passed retained ownership/pending and explicit reset recovery
functional_audit.unsupported_req_start_valid: continuously monitored inactive for unsupported banks

coverage: selected-source-only MM2S mux under legal traffic
bank completion identity distinct from sequence tag
descriptor rejection with no vendor issue or memory touch
transport fault retain and reset recovery

lint.note: lint uses interface-only memory wrapper stubs; actual XPM closure is separately proven by XSIM and Vivado OOC

synthesis.timing_exception_audit: only unplaced external-port hold paths are false-pathed; setup paths and internal reg-to-reg/RAMD32 hold paths remain timed

required_case_disposition: all frozen integration requirements passed through checked-in XSIM, independent synchronous-memory XSIM, static exact-source audit, lint, or fresh Vivado OOC evidence
limitations: This promotes only the reusable execution_fabric RTL integration packet.
Vendor DataMover IP and GEMM/systolic arithmetic remain external and were exercised only through BFMs.
No AXI BRAM Controller, PS/PL wrapper, board block design, placed/routed timing, bitstream or physical-board behavior is claimed.

The MM2S collision case is illegal by contract and structurally prevented by the serial direction engine; its priority and $onehot0 assertion were audited statically rather than by corrupting internal DUT signals.
The 0.5 ns external I/O delay and external-port hold exceptions are OOC audit assumptions and must be replaced by real integration constraints.
